value: threshold in the range of 1 m/s2 (printed 'ms2'), minimum at 1,000 Hz
method: extracellular hook-electrode recordings from the midleg leg nerve of restrained females, tibia glued to a lever; sinusoidal substrate vibration from a Bruel and Kjaer 4810 minishaker (100 ms, 2/s, six 6 dB amplitude steps, carriers 200 to 8,000 Hz), acceleration measured with an accelerometer
conditions: adult females caught in open aspen forest around the Biological Station of the University of Michigan (Pellston, MI); responses from 13 animals analysed; animal fixed ventral side up with wax-collophonium and dissected ventrally; threshold analysed as all-or-nothing, the lowest intensity giving a response to at least three of four stimuli per frequency and amplitude; the Results also print that the overall threshold is broadly tuned to vibrations from 200 to 5,000 Hz; latency fell from about 13-17 ms at threshold to 5-7 ms at larger accelerations with large variation (separate paragraph); no sex comparison (females only)

source.title: Sensing of Substrate Vibrations in the Adult Cicada Okanagana rimosa (Hemiptera: Cicadidae)
